cases.description: Key provider network outage or crash fails closed with PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; zero cached plaintext returned
Provider in sealed state returns explicit PROVIDER_SEALED and blocks decryption
Failure in attributable audit event recording aborts reveal and wipes transient plaintext
Engine and storage restart during ongoing provider outage retains fail closed with zero cached plaintext fallback
Plaintext secret bytes are owned by provider and never enter health surveillance metadata or log traces
